scenario: Series and activation-scoped facts per LSER.10.20. Series declarations are independent of the activation-scoped mechanisms of LSCP and LRST — a series tracks slot history across all activations and is not bound to any single activation's lifetime. Pin: a rule with a series-driven `where` predicate that emits a `scope activation` fact compiles cleanly.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Float mutable

schema Lock scope activation:
    entity_id: String

series Sensor.state:
    mean sliding 10_s

rule guarded:
    Sensor t where t.state > t.mean
->
    emit Lock entity_id: t.entity_id
    log info "x"
